notes.title: [BODYCAM] Roadmap Update : What's Coming Next ?!
notes.notes:
[h1]🔧 Roadmap Update – Optimization, Loadout, Zombie & More[/h1]
Hi everyone,

We’re kicking off a new format here on Steam: [b]regular updates on our roadmap progress[/b].
We usually post [i]dev leaks[/i] (images, info, early previews) on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadstudio]official Discord[/url], but since not everyone is there, we’ll now keep you updated here as well.

👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2406770/view/502817574909644245]Click here to view the full roadmap[/url]


[h2]✅ Optimization & Game Polish Part III[/h2]
This part is being handled by a [b]specialized team[/b], and they’ve already delivered key updates:
[list]  [*][b]DLSS integration[/b][/*]  [*][b]Performance and stability improvements[/b][/*]  [*][b]Polish passes across various systems[/b][/*][/list]
However, this section is [b]still ongoing[/b].
Part III : A major [b]VRAM optimization update[/b] is coming soon — it should significantly improve performance across most setups.

[h2]🔧 Loadout & Weapon System – Our Current Focus[/h2]
This is what our main team is working on right now.
We’re building a [b]completely new loadout system[/b], featuring:
[list]  [*]Fully reworked [b]weapon animations[/b][/*]  [*][b]New weapons[/b][/*]  [*][b]Thousands of attachments[/b][/*]  [*][b]Variants & skins[/b][/*]  [*]Real [b]gameplay effects per item[/b] (not just visual)[/*][/list]
Every weapon in Bodycam will now be fully customizable — with [b]thousands of unique combinations[/b].
Here are just a few examples of what you’ll be able to create using the new system — [b]every weapon in the game will be modifiable to this level of detail[/b].
First look at the [b]Raider X[/b], one of the many new weapons in development!

[h2]🛰️ New Drones Incoming[/h2]
We’re also adding [b]new types of drones[/b] to the game.
Each drone will come with its own [b]purpose[/b], [b]strengths[/b], and [b]drawbacks[/b], and we’ll explain exactly [b]how to use them[/b] and [b]what they’re meant for[/b] in future updates.

So don’t worry if you're not sure what they do yet — we’ll walk you through everything soon 😄

notes.title: Bodycam Hotfix V0.1.3.5 - Performance & Gameplay Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Bodycam Update – Hotfix V0.1.3.5 [/b][/h2]

Hey everyone

[b]We've just released last day, our biggest update yet[/b], and now here's [b]Hotfix V0.1.3.5[/b], fixing several issues and improving overall gameplay.  

Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Performance fixes[/b] on [i]Russian Building, Worn House, Hospital[/i], and other maps.[i](We've made some improvements, but keep in mind that the big performance update is coming in the next update!)[/i]
[*][b]Death tracking fixed[/b] - Death no longer counts as two deaths.
[*][b]Audio improvements[/b] - Overall sound volume levels adjusted, footsteps volume balanced, correct dirt sounds now play, and outdoor ambience works properly.
[*][b]Private match rewards[/b] - Playing in private matches no longer gives you any kind of rewards.
[*][b]Joining late[/b] - Joining a minute before the match ends now gives you no rewards.
[i]Note: No reward screen will play after the scoreboard while the match is ending.[/i]
[*][b]Rank rewards adjustments[/b] - No rank rewards when playing with bots and fewer than 3 real players.
[*][b]Hardpoint mode now ends at 200 points[/b] - Let us know if this feels too short!
[*][b]Bots now stay in matches[/b] - As asked, bots will now stay in matches until the lobby starts filling up with real players.
[*][b]Bot fixes[/b] - Bots now shoot properly, and their accuracy against other bots has been improved.
[*][b]Zombie skins fixed[/b] - They now appear correctly instead of using test assets.
[*][b]Improved match stability[/b] - Reduced chances of matches stopping abruptly.
[/list]

[center][i]As always, let us know your feedback - Thanks for your support![/i][/center]

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.3.4 - Season 2, Bots, and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]Bodycam Update V0.1.3.4 - [14/3/2025][/b]  

⚠️ [b]NOTE:[/b] 
[*]This update focuses on new content, and semi-major bug fixes, while the optimizations are being handled by a specialized team and will roll out progressively. 
[*]We would also like to mention that because of so many additions introduced in this update, there could be many bugs that we missed during bug testing stages. If you find any, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/reissadstudio]discord[/url]! 
[*]Thank you for your patience and support while we continue improving Bodycam!

---  

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]  

[b]🏆 SEASON 2 BEGINS![/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Ranks have been reset!:[/b] Players now have 60 days to climb the leaderboard before the season ends, and earn exclusive rewards! 
[*] [b]Season Rewards:[/b] You are now able to claim [b]exclusive badges[/b] as rewards for your rank position in the previous season, and [b]new operator skins[/b] for season 2!
[*] [b]View Past Rankings:[/b] You can now check your rank history by visiting the [b]Leaderboard[/b] section and selecting previous seasons.!
[*] [b]Season Duration:[/b] This season will run for [b]two months[/b], but we may adjust future seasons based on your feedback. Let us know if you prefer shorter or longer seasons!  
[*] [b]Rank Placement Change:[/b] The amount of [b]points needed to rank up has been increased exponentially[/b], making the grind [b]harder[/b] and more [b]pleasing[/b]! This change is [b]not final[/b] though, we appreciate any feedback!
[/list]  

[b]🔥 STREAK SYSTEM - DAILY FREE SKINS![/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Daily Win Rewards:[/b] Win one match per day to earn a [b]free skin.[/b]  
[*] [b]No Duplicate Skins:[/b] Skins are chosen from those you [b]do not own yet[/b].  
[*] [b]Consistency Matters:[/b] If you [b]miss a day, your streak resets![/b] Stay [b]consistent[/b] to maximize your rewards.  
[*] [b]Future Updates:[/b] More streak-based rewards will be added in [b]future updates!  [/b]
[/list]  

[b]🎯 NEW GAME MODE - HARDPOINT[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Objective-Based Gameplay:[/b] Hardpoint is a [b]fast-paced[/b] mode where teams must [b]capture and hold[/b] a rotating zone to earn points.  
[*] [b]Winning Conditions:[/b] The team that reaches [b]200 points first, or has the most points by the end of the timer[/b] wins!
[*] [b]Rotating Capture Points:[/b] The [b]zone moves periodically[/b], forcing players to anticipate rotations and reposition before the enemy does.  
[*] [b]The More The Better:[/b] The [b]more teammates[/b] you have on the [b]hardpoint[/b], the [b]more points[/b] your team receives!
[*] [b]Best for Tactical Players:[/b] Hardpoint is [b]perfect[/b] for those who enjoy a mix of [b]team strategy[/b] and [b]aggressive[/b] play-styles. Try it out, and let us know your feedback!  
[/list]  

[b]🗺️ NEW MAP - PAINTBALL ARENA[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Designed for Competitive Modes:[/b] A [b]paintball-inspired map[/b] tailored for [b]Versus, Body Bomb, and Hardpoint[/b] game modes.  
[*] [b]Ground-Level Combat:[/b] Unlike Airsoft, Bomb House, or Russian Building, [b]this map has no elevated areas[/b], ensuring a level playing field.  
[*] [b]Cover-Based Movement:[/b] Small, scattered [b]covers[/b] force players to stay [b]mobile and react quickly[/b] to enemy movement.  
[*] [b]Symmetrical Layout:[/b] The map is [b]evenly designed[/b], providing a balanced and fair competitive experience.  
[/list]  

---  

[b]🤖 BOTS - DYNAMIC MATCHMAKING AI[/b]  
[i]NOTE: The bots are not perfect just yet, and will be improved over time![/i]
[list]  
[*] [b]Dynamic Matchmaking Support:[/b] Bots [b]automatically fill empty slots[/b] and [b]leave as real players join[/b]. They are designed to [b]maintain the game’s pacing and balance.[/b]  
[*] [b]Filling Lobbies & Expanding Player Base:[/b] Bots have been added to [b]ensure that matches feel full[/b] and [b]competitive[/b], particularly in regions where the player base is still growing. This helps Bodycam [b]expand globally[/b] and improves matchmaking speeds.  
[*] [b]Adaptive AI Difficulty:[/b] Bots [b]start at an easier level[/b] but [b]dynamically adjust their difficulty[/b] based [b]on player performance[/b]. If you're dominating, they will get [b]smarter and more challenging[/b] for you.  
[*] [b]Realistic Player Behavior:[/b] Bots [b]analyze the battlefield[/b], take alternative routes, use flanking tactics, and engage dynamically in fights.  
[*] [b]Objective-Focused AI:[/b] Bots [b]interact with objectives just like real players[/b]; They plant and defuse bombs, capture Hardpoints, and support their team in tactical engagements.  
[*] [b]Option to disable bots:[/b] If you're hosting a match, you can [b]disable bots in the settings[/b] before starting a match!  
[*] [b]Bot Kill Point Rewards:[/b] Killing a bot [b]grants ¼ of a player kill's value[/b]. For example, if a player kill grants 40 RPoints, a bot kill will grant 10 RPoints.
[*] [b]Temporary bot limit:[/b] For testing, bots will [b]fill lobbies up to 4 players[/b] for the time being![/list]  

---  

[b]🌍 MAP REWORKS & FIXES[/b]  
We have started reworking several maps to improve visual quality, level design, and balance. However, this is just the beginning! These improvements are [b]not[/b] final. This is a first step to better organization and testing community feedback before the [b]full map overhauls planned in the 2025 roadmap.[/b]

[list]  
[*] [b]Worn House Revamped:[/b] Improved textures, lighting, and overall level design for better balance and visuals.  
[*] [b]Russian Building Now Features a Redesigned Outside Area:[/b] Expanded for more strategic opportunities and improved navigation.  
[*] [b]A New Staircase Has Been Added To Russian Building:[/b] Changing the way players navigate and making gameplay more dynamic.
[*] [b]Airsoft House Optimizations:[/b] The map has seen a considerable amount of changes and optimizations, removing annoying spots and more, making gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.
[*] [b]Training Range Now Has New Guns:[/b] FOSTECH shotgun and Revolver have been added to training range for everyone to test them out!  
[*] [b]Countless hitboxes fixed across all the maps:[/b] Including Russian Building trees, Rome's bushes, and more!
[*] [b]"Logistics" Was temporarily disabled for a small rework[/b]  
[/list]  

---  

[b]🎨 SKINS & CUSTOMIZATION UPDATES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]37+7 New Operator Skins Added![/b] There's 37 new skins you can buy in the shop, and 7 more you can get from season rewards!
[*] [b]A handful of new weapons skins![/b] A couple more weapon skins were added this update for some guns!
[*] [b]New National Flag Badges Added:[/b] Represent your country with pride! All nations now have unique flag badges.  
[*] [b]More Badges Coming Soon:[/b] Future updates will introduce new badges with different meanings and significance.  
[*] [b]Profile Picture Now Reflects Your Operator Skin:[/b] Your in-game avatar is now represented by your chosen operator skin, adding more immersion and natural team identification. We would like your feedback regarding this change, let us know if you like it or not!
[/list]  

---  

[b]OTHER ADDITIONS, CHANGES, FIXES & POLISH[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Added voice lines that play at start of rounds and other situations[/b]  
[*] [b]Added [RADIO] audio setting, that controls the previously mentioned voice lines[/b]  
[*] [b]Added Take/Interact key bind option (Default: E)[/b]  
[*] [b]Added a new scope[/b]  
[*] [b]Added new walking sounds[/b]  
[*] [b]Reworked Main Menu UI completely[/b]  
[i]Note: [u]UI Bugs are still present, this is just the first part of the UI rework![/u][/i]
[*] [b]Nerfed and Buffed rank point rewards for certain gamemodes[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved and adjusted the friendly name UI[/b] 
[*] [b]Team killers are now automatically kicked after 3 TKs, regardless of their performance in the match[/b] 
[*] [b]Friendly "Green Box" no longer disappears when too close, minimizing confusion and accidental team kills[/b] 
[*] [b]Joining a match too late will no longer grant you any rewards, preventing players from abusing the system by joining late and getting free rewards.[/b] 
[*] [b]Players will no longer earn any points in private matches. These games will be purely for practice.[/b] 
[*] [b]RTSS (Riva Tuner Statistics Server) works again[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved the player hit registration[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved issues with body bomb rounds not ending properly[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved issue where lasers unintentionally lit up entire rooms[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved issues with private lobbies not working[/b]  
[*] [b]Resolved issues with pump shotgun and revolver getting stuck[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issue with weapon skins not saving if you don't have an operator skin equipped[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issues with the resolution not being saved[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issues with the shop being empty[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issues with the bomb not dropping from dead players[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issue where lasers caused a large red flash when turned on[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed bug that disabled the green box and names of friendlies at the start of a match[/b]  
[*] [b]Players can no longer steal the bomb from a teammate[/b]  
[*] [b]Ranks are now spelled correctly[/b]  
[*] [b]Voice chat volume is no longer affected by the "Master Volume" setting[/b]  
[/list]
[b]+ COUNTLESS other smaller bug fixes and changes![/b]

notes.title: Quick Update On The Progress
notes.notes:
This announcement was posted on 23/01/2025 in our [url=https://discord.gg/reissadstudio]Discord[/url]!

We wanted to take a moment to update you on things. We know you’ve been waiting and like to hear from us, so here’s where we’re at right now:

We’re working on a [b]big update[/b] that’s coming soon. It will include things like [b]bots[/b], the start of a [b]new season[/b], many [b]bug fixes[/b], and several [b]new functionalities[/b]! It’s a very ambitious update that has taken a lot of time already, especially after the holiday season.

Meanwhile, we’ve been doing more than just working on the game. Yes, we’re taking our time... but only to make sure it’s well thought out and achievable!
We will present all the [b]amazing features[/b] that it will include, [b]share our vision[/b], and [b]even explain[/b] how we plan to bring them to life!
This will also be a great opportunity for you to share your own [b]suggestions[/b] about what you’d like to be [b]prioritized[/b] and what is [b]important[/b] to you.

[*] And last, we will announce the [b]major 1.3.4 update[/b], detailing all the new features and changes!


Thank you so much for your patience, and thank you again for your support, we couldn’t have pushed this project to such lengths without you!

See you soon for these exciting announcements!

[b][h3]Reissad Studio[/h3][/b]

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.3.3 - 2 New Maps, Rework, and Changes!
notes.notes:
[b]Bodycam Update V0.1.3.3 - November 11, 2024[/b]

⚠️ [b]NOTE:[/b] This update focuses on new content, while bug fixes are being handled by a specialized team and will roll out progressively. We appreciate your patience and support as we continue improving Bodycam.

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Rome (New Map):[/b] A large, intricately designed map featuring a mix of open spaces and tight corridors. Optimized for Bomb Mode, it introduces multiple strategic planting zones to intensify tactical gameplay.  
[*] [b]Logistics (New Map):[/b] One of the smallest maps in Bodycam, tailored for Versus Mode and 1v1 Duel Mode. Designed for close-quarters combat, it ensures action-packed matches as opposing teams face off head-to-head.  
[*] [b]Oil Rig Returns:[/b] Back by popular demand, this map has been reintroduced with some incomplete features (e.g., missing floors). Improvements will continue based on community feedback.  
[*] [b]Tumblewood Temporarily Disabled:[/b] This map is currently under rework. Stay tuned for updates!  
[/list]  

[b]CHANGES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Bomb Mode Zones:[/b] Added strategic A, B, and C planting zones. Planting here cuts detonation time in half, offering more tactical depth. Default planting rules remain for strategic flexibility.  
[*] [b]Versus Rounds Adjustments:[/b] Reduced the number of rounds to win from seven to five. Sides now switch after two or three rounds, depending on progress, for faster, more dynamic matches.  
[*] [b]Lighting and Shadow Fixes:[/b] Shadows are now enforced for all players, preventing unfair advantages from file manipulation while maintaining immersion.  
[*] [b]Bad Host Punishment:[/b] Hosts that leave before the match ends will now be penalized.  
[*] [b]General Map Updates:[/b] Minor tweaks and adjustments have been made to improve gameplay flow and visuals across all maps.  
[/list]  

[b]FIXES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Lighting Exploits:[/b] Fixed bugs allowing players to disable shadows unfairly.  
[*] [b]Generator Timing in Zombie Mode:[/b] Resolved issues where generators activated at incorrect intervals.  
[*] [b]Collision in Pit Mode:[/b] Improved collision mechanics for smoother gameplay.  
[*] [b]Bomb Mode Timers:[/b] Adjusted planting and detonation mechanics for better balance.  
[/list]  

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] 8 new skins added.  
[*] R point rewards and shop prices adjusted.  
[*] Vaulting mechanics limited for realism and to prevent accessing unreachable spots.  
[*] Teams with friends now auto-balance better.  
[*] Knife knockback adjusted.  
[*] Grenade kills now count properly.  
[*] Fixed collision and stuck spots across all maps.  
[*] "The Pit" mode renamed to "Duel."  
[*] Kicking disabled in GunGame and Deathmatch modes due to abuse.  
[*] Scoreboard and lobby settings improvements.  
[*] Fixed labels in settings for better clarity.  
[/list]  

[b]RANK RESET & SEASONS (COMMUNITY SUGGESTION)[/b]  
We are exploring the idea of a rank reset paired with a seasonal structure to enhance the competitive experience:  
[list]  
[*] [b]Season Duration:[/b] Each season will last 1-2 months, with ranks resetting at the end.  
[*] [b]Seasonal Rewards:[/b] Earn exclusive skins based on your rank at the season's end.  
[*] [b]Rank History:[/b] Track your performance and ranks across previous seasons in a dedicated section.  
[/list]  

💬 [b]Community Question:[/b] Should we start the next season immediately (with rewards distributed later) or wait until the reward system is fully implemented? Share your thoughts in the ⁠Suggestions channel!  

Thank you for your continued support, and see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.3.2 - R-Points X2 & New Skins
notes.notes:
[b]Bodycam Update V0.1.3.2 - November 7, 2024[/b]

[b]⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]R-Points Reset & Shop Update[/b]: All players’ R-Points have been reset due to fixes addressing fraud issues and a rework of the point calculation system. To compensate, R-Points earned will be doubled during the first week!
[*] This change is essential to improve the R-Points system and correct past fraud issues.
[/list]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Full Character Skins: We’re transitioning from customizable parts to full character skins. This change allows us to create more detailed and cohesive skins, enhancing both visual quality and game optimization. It also simplifies customization by eliminating the need to match every piece with existing options, opening up new creative possibilities.
Unlocks: If you’ve previously unlocked specific items like hats, don’t worry—you’ll receive full character skins when they are released! We’ll replace the existing 300+ custom skins in the database with full character skins, so many of you will find new skins in your inventory.

[*] [b]New Weapon Skins[/b]: Added numerous new weapon skins, including seasonal themes like Halloween, for more customization options.
[*] [b]Shop with R-Points[/b]: The shop has been revamped to allow direct purchases with R-Points or real money. Players can now view all unowned items in their locker to plan acquisitions.
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Zombie Mode[/b]: Fixed bugs and optimized gameplay for smoother experiences.
[*] [b]Zombie Respawn System[/b]: Players now respawn closer to their teammates in zombie mode.
[*] [b]Zombie Spawns[/b]: Added more spawn points to prevent camping.
[*] [b]Lobby Character Visuals[/b]: Improved character visuals in the lobby for better display quality.
[*] [b]Friend List Enhancement[/b]: Group members are now highlighted, making it easier to see who has joined your party.
[*] [b]Blood System[/b]: Enhanced the blood system for more realistic effects.
[*] [b]R-Points in Zombie Mode[/b]: Players will now earn R-Points when completing a game in zombie mode.
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]R-Points System[/b]: Reworked for better security and fairness.
[*] [b]Map Enhancements[/b]: Adjusted map layouts based on community feedback for improved play.
[*] [b]Ragdoll Physics[/b]: Refined for more realistic character movement.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Crash on Start[/b]: Fixed an issue causing matches to crash at startup.
[*] [b]Character Quality[/b]: Resolved issues where character quality appeared low at specific moments.
[*] [b]Generator Activation[/b]: Fixed an issue where generators would activate in the next wave instead of the current one.
[*] [b]Collision Bug in Pit Mode[/b]: Corrected a collision issue to ensure smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Head Shadows[/b]: Fixed an issue where head shadows were not cast correctly.
[/list]

Don’t forget to leave a review on Steam or support the game by purchasing a small skin—it’s greatly appreciated! Your feedback is always welcome.

[b]The Reissad Team[/b]

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.2.8: New Maps, Modes, and Key Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Bodycam update V0.1.2.8[/b]

[b]SUMMARY[/b]  
Bodycam update V0.1.2.8 introduces two new maps, "Public Pool" and "The Pit," along with new game modes: a 1v1 duel and Team Death Match. The update also features reworks of existing maps, including balancing adjustments and improved gameplay elements, alongside enhanced UI and various fixes for a smoother experience.


[b]ADDED[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]NEW MAP : Public Pool[/b]  
Fight through a derelict public pool complex, offering close quarters combat and open areas for intense gunfights.  
[*] [b]NEW MAP : The Pit[/b]  
An arena-style map designed for intense 1v1 duels, with randomized layouts for each match. *(ONLY AVAILABLE IN THE NEW "THE PIT" MODE)*  
[*] [b]NEW GAMEMODE : The Pit[/b]  
1V1 duel with the map changing each round. Perfect game mode to face your friends and find out who is the strongest.  
[*] [b]NEW GAMEMODE : Team Death Match[/b]  
(2 teams with respawn enabled, first team to reach 100 kills wins).  
[/list]

[b]INFORMATIONS[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Gamemode Name Switch :[/b]  
The previous "Team Deathmatch" is now called [b]Versus[/b], to make room for the new traditional Team Death Match mode.  
[*] [b]Team Selection System Improved :[/b]  
Team selection now takes place at the start of the game and cannot be changed in-game for better balancing.  
[*] [b]Contributors Graffiti Added :[/b]  
All the contributors' graffiti have been added to the training map and some will appear in future maps or in reworks of old maps!  
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Russian Building Modified and Improved :[/b]  
Added new paths and made balancing adjustments.  
[*] [b]Abandoned Hospital Modified and Improved :[/b]  
Various collision fixes for smoother gameplay.  
[*] [b]Worn House Modified and Improved :[/b]  
Added new paths, new visuals, and made balancing adjustments.  
[*] [b]Player Spawn System :[/b]  
We improved the spawn system by making it more intelligent and flexible for all game modes, like spawning automatically next to your allies in modes that allow it.  
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Scoreboard Improved :[/b]  
Enhanced visuals and added player ranks next to their names.  
[*] [b]Settings Improved :[/b]  
Visuals improved and you can now change your lobby settings in the settings menu.  
[*] [b]UI : Map & Gamemode Selection :[/b]  
You now select the mode first, then the maps available for that mode. Unique and mode-specific maps are labeled accordingly. We've also added labels like "new," "updated," "patch," and more to keep you informed on each mode and map's status.  
[/list]

[b]PLAYER[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Player Skin reacts to the Dynamic Weather :[/b]  
Depending on the weather, your clothing accessories will now react to it, making characters even more realistic.  
[*] [b]Player reacts to Flashbang and Scream :[/b]  
Now you can tell if your enemies are under the effect of your flashbang by hearing them scream. Be careful, as the effect may vary depending on how the enemy received the flash.  
[*] [b]Aiming Sensitivity and Balancing :[/b]  
FPS-dependent adjustment of aiming sensitivity and motion balancing. For players with high or low FPS, camera movements will now remain consistent.  
[*] [b]Camera :[/b]  
Improved camera movement and effects, including reworked leaning mechanics.  
[*] [b]Right/Left Sprinting :[/b]  
Added right and left sprinting options for enhanced mobility.  
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Dead Body Performance Optimization :[/b]  
Reduced performance impact caused by dead bodies.  
[*] [b]Gun Game Weapon Swap Fix :[/b]  
Addressed weapon swap issues in Gun Game mode.  
[*] [b]Bunny Hop Fix :[/b]  
Fixed issues with bunny hopping.  
[*] [b]Mantle Animation Fix :[/b]  
Resolved animation issues when mantling.  
[*] [b]Inventory Drop Fix :[/b]  
Fixed problems with dropping items from the inventory.  
[*] [b]R-Points/Rank Points System Reworked :[/b]  
Improved rank points attribution for better progression tracking.  
[/list]

[b]BETA[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Localization and Translation (All text not yet translated and will default to English) :[/b]  
Added support for the following languages: French, Chinese, Russian, Dutch.  
[/list]

[b]Have a great weekend![/b]
